delivery-order.text: The work begins with a clean model-bound baseline and draft pull request. The coder splits three responsibilities behind one facade, preserving verification's extra checks. A focused cage test must execute attach and observe resolved outputs and a refusal. Independent review precedes the handoff.

evidence-limits-and-gates.text: A build alone cannot prove a script identity refusal. A supported local devnet check must accept the intact manifest and reject a changed script identity. It does not prove every attachment query. The retained journey mirror check stays a separately named evidence limit.

source-to-criterion-witnesses.text: The table separates three witnesses. Focused tests check manifest and mirror fixtures, and call attach with a controlled provider. A new required CI step drives deployment verify on a local devnet with an intact and changed script identity. The latter does not prove every attach query.
